name: scatter-chart
title: Scatter chart
description: Scatter and bubble chart with axis labels, groups by color and a nearest-point hover. Points pop in one by one on scroll.
htmlExample:
<bef-scatter-chart class="w-full max-w-xl" x-label="Hours" y-label="Score" :groups='[{"name":"Class A"},{"name":"Class B"}]' :points='[
  {"x":1,"y":42,"group":0},{"x":2,"y":55,"group":0},{"x":3,"y":61,"group":0},{"x":4,"y":72,"group":0},{"x":1.5,"y":35,"group":1},{"x":3,"y":48,"group":1},{"x":5,"y":66,"group":1}]'></bef-scatter-chart>
